window_definition.command_prefix: prepared command i included iff 5*i < original first failure internal step
window_definition.force_prefix: completed internal sample j included iff j < original first failure internal step
window_definition.success_endpoint: horizon censored; no invented failure time

measurement_definition.resolved_correction: rate-limited correction before final target-speed projection
measurement_definition.delivered_correction: final native velocity target minus deterministic baseline velocity target
measurement_definition.force: retained unit-gear affine actuator and joint force before integration
measurement_definition.contact_geometry: canonical reported supporting contact points projected to the horizontal plane
measurement_definition.center_of_mass: retained torso-root subtree center of mass, converted to canonical coordinates
measurement_definition.contact_load: unavailable values remain null; motor torque is not a foot load
measurement_definition.hull_margin: signed minimum edge distance only for at least three noncollinear hull vertices
measurement_definition.interpretation: descriptive exposed trajectories; no force-feasibility, independent-sample, or causal proof
